$scope: app/(exec) surfaces only. The generator and future exec.css consume this file; no CSS value may exist that is not derived from it.

colorUsage.$contract: every (color, minSize, minWeight) text pairing must pass the APCA floor for that size/weight; the build validator enforces this

rules.red: dots any; text 16px+ at 400/460 serif only; at most one red text run per page (the lede stuck-count)
rules.amber: dots only — Lc 75.3 fails the 13px/500 floor, so amber text is banned
rules.budget: no tinted background fills anywhere; status color appears only on 8px dots and the single red lede phrase; chips are ink-2 text, uncolored

type.$scale: Utopia fluid: min 15px/1.14 at 320px viewport, max 16px/1.2 at 1240px; steps emitted as clamp() computed by the generator, never hand-typed
type.fontLoad: variable instances only: Newsreader ital,opsz,wght 400..700; Inter wght 400..700
type.casePolicy: no uppercase-transformed text anywhere on the surface; sentence case only (removes the tracked-caps floor problem by construction)

space.$grid: 4px; no spacing value off this scale

reqGrid.$tracks: role | recruiter | open | in-process | in-review | furthest — numbers right-aligned so columns scan vertically

reqGridV3.$tracks: role | recruiter | awaiting-review | pipeline strip (6 slots) | last-14d — the content-contract row: current pipeline stage-by-stage + trailing movement

layout.containerQuery: components respond to the page container; below 720px row grids collapse to a stacked two-line layout and the masthead index drops beneath the lede

density.$targets: declared per surface, checked at review
density.reqRow: one grid line + at most one sub-line (activity/finalists merged); 44–72px per req
density.aboveTheFold: masthead lede + index + first stuck group visible at 1440x900

elevation.$decision: flat surface, declared: level 0 only. This is a briefing document register; layering is done with hairline/rule strength, never shadows

motion.properties: color, text-decoration-color, transform, opacity only; never transition: all
motion.reducedMotion: all transitions and smooth scroll disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

affordance.links: underlined at rest (decoration at 35% link color), full-strength decoration on hover; color alone never carries interactivity
affordance.disclosure: native details/summary with a rotating marker and link-style summary for any 'N more' truncation
affordance.chips: non-interactive labels have no border (border reads as button); chip = 13px/500 colored text only
affordance.focus: 2px solid link-color outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element via :focus-visible

states.$matrix: every state designed, not just happy path
states.unavailable: no snapshot yet: masthead + one-sentence explanation + what will appear; no skeleton chrome
states.stale: as-of older than 26h: amber banner line under masthead stating age and expected refresh; page still renders
states.emptyGroup: a health group with zero reqs is omitted entirely (never a headless section); if ALL stuck groups are empty the Stuck section renders one green-dot sentence
states.partialData: when the snapshot reports stage-taxonomy gaps, a single footnote line names the count; never inline per-row warnings
states.loading: N/A — server-rendered from a durable snapshot; no client fetch exists
